label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 44
title: MVP: user-selectable deployment target (Vercel / managed cloud / self-hosted / remote Linux or Windows host)
body: Owner (P40): the dashboard must let the user SELECT the deployment target per project/run, including a REMOTE Linux or Windows host, not only the hosted default. Targets: (a) hosted SaaS default - Vercel static dashboard + managed cloud API/workers/DB/queue; (b) self-hosted/co-located (single host); (c) remote Linux/Windows machine (deploy over SSH/Docker/WinRM). Drives the pipeline's target advisor / deploy providers (core/target_advisor.py, core/target_selector.py, core/deploy_providers.py, core/net_ports.py, docker_compose_generator) and shows dev/staging/prod environments. Extends BI-0036 (build/release/VCS) and BI-0041 (deploy family).
